Class Axis

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.views.common.Axis
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Axis extends Object implements Serializable
Axis definition for a numerical axis in a chart display, e.g. line, bar, timing, etc.

      public Axis(String title, String units, Optional<Double> minTicValue, Optional<Double> maxTicValue, double majorTicValue, int minorTicCount)
      Constructor
      Parameters:
      title - Title of the axis, not including the parenthetical units portion
      units - Parenthetical units portion of the title
      minTicValue - Optional minimum value on the axis. Chart will automatically determine min value from data if value is not present.
      maxTicValue - Optional maximum value on the axis. Chart will automatically determine max value from data if value is not present.
      majorTicValue - Increment between major (numbered) tics on the axis
      minorTicCount - Number of tics between the major tics.
